hero.title: Physiotherapy in Finland
hero.subtitle: Study Physiotherapy in Finland to gain comprehensive rehabilitation and clinical movement-science training in a modern European healthcare system.

overview: For Indian students interested in Physiotherapy abroad, Finland offers structured Bachelor of Health Care (Physiotherapy) programmes at leading Universities of Applied Sciences, combining anatomy, biomechanics, and supervised clinical placements.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide assists students in exploring Physiotherapy in Finland, understanding language and admission requirements, and planning their study-abroad journey.

seo.title: Physiotherapy in Finland for Indian Students | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Study Physiotherapy in Finland: Bachelor of Health Care (Physiotherapy), top UAS universities (Metropolia UAS, JAMK UAS), clinical placements, fees, and Valvira licensing.
